config.trinkets-tooltip.pagination.toolt: Split the panel into pages with previous/next arrows, like Curios. Turn off to lay every slot out at once.
config.trinkets-tooltip.min_width.toolti: Columns per page. Only used when pagination is enabled.
config.trinkets-tooltip.scrolling_outsid: Turning pages with the mouse wheel works anywhere in the inventory, not just over the panel.
Left clicking an empty trinket slot opens JEI listing every item that can be equipped there.
